idea: [A2-A5] portal arms on the unit-span base (MED_USE_QUOTE=0 + attach): A2 MED_MULTI_FALLBACK=qoverlap; A3 MED_SPAN_COVERAGE_NEXT=1; A4 MED_UNIT_MODE=clause; A5 MED_UNIT_MODE=phrase
lesson: sentence units are the right granularity on unseen conversations (clause/phrase units lose 0.014-0.016); picking the cluster by question-word overlap loses 0.008 (first cluster stays best); the coverage-next end extension adds a marginal +0.003. Next: edge rules on the A3 base (A6-A9), results in medical/out/portal_arms.tsv

idea: [A6-A9, A3b] edge rules on the A3 base (units + coverage-next + attach): A6 MED_SPAN_SHIFT_E=-0.2; A7 start +0.3 (MED_ALLOW_SHIFT_WITH_ONSET=1); A8 onset rule off; A9 MED_SPAN_SNAP=1; A3b = A3 re-run
status: all discard; A3 config stays served
lesson: the unit-span path is NOT deterministic on the portal: the same config scored 0.7612 and 0.7517 (LLM citation variance changes whole-sentence spans), so the run noise is ~+-0.005 and A1/A3 vs attach (+0.005..+0.011) is the real size of the unit gain. Every edge rule loses: trimming ends -0.01, shifting starts +0.3 s -0.03, dropping the onset rule -0.005, pause snapping -0.01. Next lever: reduce citation variance (self-consistency over sampled citations)

idea: [SC5/SC9/A3c] citation self-consistency (MED_SC_N sampled replies, majority first cluster) on the A3 base; A3c = third run of A3
lesson: sampling 5-9 replies costs 10-12 s/conv under GPU contention; the vote reduces variance a little but does not move the mean; the location errors are systematic, not sampling noise

idea: [AEQ] verdict-first prompt (MED_ORDER=aeq) on the unit-span base (units + coverage-next + attach)
status: promising (top single number; +0.006 over the A3 mean, inside +-0.005 noise)
lesson: on the old quote path aeq lost 0.010 on the portal; with cited-unit spans the verdict-first order is at least neutral and probably slightly positive; needs a repeat before it becomes the default

idea: [CLS/CLSP] clause snap of the aligned quote (MED_USE_QUOTE=1 MED_SPAN_CLAUSE_SNAP=1, pause 1.0 / 0.4) + coverage-next + attach
lesson: widening the verbatim quote to its clause loses 0.02: the quote itself is misplaced/misaligned on unseen conversations, not just short; the cited-sentence unit is the right span source

Prompt wording is exhausted: v1->v3 was +0.02 by removing over-extension, two more true bullets move 13 questions 5 better/7 worse
